title: Positive exactness of small free abelian Cech presheaf chains
statement: Let $C$ be a category with objects in universe $u$ and Hom sets in $v$, with finite wide pullbacks. Let $X\in C$, let $I$ be a type in $v$, and let $\pi_i:U_i\to X$ be any family. In degree $n$, define the presheaf $T_n(Z)=\coprod_{t:\mathrm{Fin}(n+1)\to I}\operatorname{Hom}_C(Z,(\prod_{j}\,(U_{t(j)}\to X)).\mathrm{left})$. Restriction precomposes the represented maps. Faces delete the indicated coordinate using the product projection. Apply the free abelian group functor objectwise and take the alternating chain complex $K$, with differential $\sum_j(-1)^j\delta_j$. Then $K$ is exact at $q+1$ for every $q\in\mathbb N$. No covering or injectivity condition is required.

source.place: Tag 03AT (lemma-homology-complex), with the complex of Tag 03AS

proof.text: Evaluate at any object Z and partition the degree-n basis by the common composite Z -> X. The product universal property identifies each fibre with (n+1)-tuples of lifts of that composite to the family. Projections delete entries, preserving the fibre. All basis sets are v-small.

For each nonempty lift set choose one lift and prepend it to every tuple. The first face of this insertion is the identity; its remaining faces are insertions after deleting an entry, with opposite signs. Extending to the free abelian group proves d h + h d = id in positive degrees. Empty lift sets give zero chain groups. This is the explicit homotopy argument in Stacks 03AT.

The free group on the disjoint union is the direct sum of its fibre groups. A cycle has finite support, so the fibrewise primitives combine to a primitive in that direct sum. Kernels and cokernels of abelian presheaves are computed objectwise; therefore the evaluated exactness proves exactness of K at q+1.
